items.acceptance: Both releases have explicit scope decisions accepted in review.
items.result: Local contract remains in review. The founder accepted discovery-first coverage, relevance evaluation, and harness-adoption priorities on 2026-10-27. A deployed preview does not establish full PRD acceptance.

items.acceptance: One documented journey quotes observed output, identifies a concrete breakdown and tests a focused improvement.

items.acceptance: Every product claim has evidence; sensitive paths are redacted; publication remains a separate founder decision.

items.acceptance: Record customer evidence, a falsifiable paid-use hypothesis and a continue/change/stop decision.

items.acceptance: Founder approves provider data scope and budget, credentials are configured, and a bounded proposal is reviewed.
items.blocker: Live API policy is disabled; no API key, model or spending authorization is configured.

items.task: Make the company public and align its operating documents with building in public.
items.acceptance: GitHub visibility is public; the decision, roadmap and publishing boundaries reflect the founder's direction.
items.result: Company visibility verified public on 2026-10-18; proprietary license retained.

items.task: Draft a public walkthrough of how we design roles, maintain living documents and review agent proposals.
items.acceptance: Use actual repository evidence, distinguish the offline prototype from live workers, and identify one organizational experiment to evaluate next. Posting to other channels remains a separate founder decision.

items.task: Implement and locally activate verified fixes for the first audit's measurement failures.
items.acceptance: Built-ins are covered, illustrative paths no longer fail dependency checks, unrelated lexical controls abstain, and the patch is tested and available for review.
items.result: Skill PR 1 merged. All 60 Python regressions and Python 3.11-3.13 CI passed; saved lexical cases improved from 10/12 to 12/12.

items.task: Compare fresh Codex baseline tasks with one reversible duplicate-disable pilot.
items.acceptance: Verify one fewer duplicate catalog entry and compare the same tasks, input facts and model settings before and after. Record selected paths and completed outcomes; retain or restore the saved configuration from evidence.
items.result: Raw cases, separate rubric and recovery steps are ready. No setting changed or fresh-session outcome measured.
items.defer_reason: Discovery validation takes priority under the founder direction accepted on 2026-10-27.

items.task: Replace the public skill Python runtime with a portable native Go CLI.
items.acceptance: All five command domains run in Go; native tests, recovery compatibility, OS CI, six bundles and an interpreter-free installed smoke check pass. Preserve the company proprietary license.
items.result: Skill PR 2 merged and installed with backup. All 86 native tests and seven CI jobs pass. Company worker code and proprietary license are unchanged.

items.task: Address verified Devin cleanup friction in batch storage, default roots and report interpretation.
items.acceptance: Selected skills preview, archive and restore in one transaction; invalid inputs move nothing. Default discovery finds Devin CLI globals; help and JSON fields match behavior.
items.result: All 45 archive restore previews pass. Skill PR 3 adds batch storage and native roots; 89 native tests pass.

items.task: Expand canonical discovery coverage with a documented registry connector and upstream revision mapping.
items.acceptance: PRD stage B passes at 500 distinct directories across two source kinds. Record changes, removals, repeated ingestion, extraction failure, fork handling, freshness, and task-family coverage.

items.task: Freeze and run a representative relevance evaluation against lexical retrieval and accessible competing discovery paths.
items.acceptance: Freeze 100 human-reviewed prompts before final tuning. At least 40 of 50 relevant prompts have an approved top-three match. Report no-match behavior, catalog differences, latency, and limitations without inferring general superiority from a single query.

items.task: Demonstrate automatic discovery and accepted adoption in fresh Codex sessions, then repeat in a second harness.
items.acceptance: PRD AC-04, AC-05, and AC-06 pass with harness and model versions recorded. Search calls, suggestions, rejection, pinned loading, and matched original-task outcomes have separate evidence.

items.task: Complete the controlled discovery pilot and prepare a launch decision with unmet criteria visible.
items.acceptance: Record the remaining PRD parity, failure, security, latency, cost, and 48-hour operating checks. Product and founder review the resulting release claims.
